in teaching at Seattle University, I taught in the Seattle Public Schools for nine years.
So for me the first surprise in restaurant ownership is that I owned a restaurant.
On January 13th 2006, Siebe and I were more or less coerced into driving up to would be

wrote a business plan and would be Allen Bank decided to give us some money and we had

Running a public business in a small town has its challenges. The rumor mill in Langley

skin than I ever thought I would have to as an elementary school teacher. Siebe and I
have been together for 22 years and operating a restaurant is not easy on a marriage. One
of my favorite quotes about restaurant life is by a Seattle restaurant owner and she

youtube_description:
About the talk: A sudden career change led to lessons she never expected.  

About the speaker : When she taught 1st-grade, Jenn Jurriaans, now co-owner of Prima Bistro and mother of two girls, never dreamed she'd one day be managing 30 adult employees instead of 30 6-year-olds. 

Jenn spoke at WOW!Stories 2015, a production of Seriously Fun Productions, at the Whidbey Island Center for the Arts. This video was filmed and edited by WhidbeyTV.
